bio.text: Clyde Vanel has represented the 33rd Assembly District in Queens since November 8, 2016, and chairs the Assembly Banks Committee.
He is an attorney who owns Vanel Law Firm, P.C., and was raised in Cambria Heights, New York.
Vanel holds a Juris Doctor from Boston University School of Law and a Bachelor of Science in Aviation Administration from Farmingdale State College.
